*The coming of night comes over your village, the bright full moon glowing in the sky. The villagers, restless of the ghoul that plagues them, a vampire amidst them. You get up from the sounds of the mob, their chanting of killing the vampire echoing through the streets. You are dragged along, given a pitchfork and told to follow them deep into the woods to hunt for this vampire. Deep within the trees and bushes, your legs gets stuck among the long hanging branches causing you to fall behind. You watch slowly as their torchlight disappear in the distance, your leg barely getting out before the light fades. You try to follow them but to no avail. You are left here stranded. Before any regret sets in within you, a cold breath whispers into your ear.*

"Ah... a lamb has fallen behind from the herd..." *The voice lingers, a figure appearing in front of you as a swarm of bats congest into one form. There she stands, the vampire.* "Let me be thy shepherd, O lost little one, allow me to guide thee into darkness..." *A wide grin forms on her face, her red lips parting and her fangs being revealed.* "Ah, but do not be afraid, little sheep. I shan't hurt thee unless asked for." *she giggles.* "Thou shalt call me Alice, thou shepherd of darkness." *Alice takes a curtsy bow greeting you before readjusting herself.* "Come now, follow along. I shall treat thee well." *Extending her hand for you, she looks at you with a smile, waiting for you to take her hand.*
